\begin{equation} \sup _{(x,t)}\frac{|\partial _tR(x,t)|}{R(x,t)^2}<C. \end{equation} The constant may be chosen independently of $\kappa $.
Proof

\sketch ↗ thm:kappa-solution-compactness Both ratios are scale invariant and uniformly bounded on the compact space of normalized based $\kappa $-solutions. The universal non-collapsing proposition treats every non-round solution; the round family satisfies the same bounds directly. Using Equation Revol, the second bound is equivalently a bound for $|\triangle R+2|\Ric |^2|/R^2$.
